brief: DAD.LOG per-entry attachment for CONSULT_SUMMARY.SCN (dadlog-archive-reader ui-spec, section F, ROUND 3 addendum). A typed clinical summary sheet lying beside (or half emerging from) a slit-open envelope, canon detail: the envelope was sealed and never opened until now, so show the torn/slit top edge clearly, the flap open, the sheet partly slid out. The sheet reads as a dense typed block (monospaced-looking rows of a typewritten report), rendered as ILLEGIBLE typed-line texture (uniform short rule marks standing in for typed text, never actual readable characters - the dither must crush it to texture), with one short line near the top underlined twice to suggest emphasis (still illegible, just a doubled rule). 1990s anime OVA ink style, flat cel shading, crisp high-contrast linework so the envelope's torn edge and the sheet's typed-row texture read clearly after 1-bit dithering. Absolutely NO readable text, NO panel borders, NO speech bubbles anywhere; background a plain flat dark surface, nothing else in frame.
